_note: `bind:checked`, `bind:files`, `bind:innerHTML`, `bind:paused` and the get/set form are attributes of the element upstream (`"bind:checked": EXPR`, `"bind:value": __sveltets_2_get_set_binding(get, set)`), checked by the element's attribute type from `svelte/elements`. Positions follow upstream's source map: a mismatched value reports at the directive's `=` when it is the tag's first attribute and at the last character of the preceding attribute otherwise; a get/set mismatch reports at the getter. Our hand-typed assertions reported at the bound expression instead, and `bind:value={n}` on a plain `<input>` (line 9) was a false TS2322.
